scope: Exclusive fractions use the rank with the largest parent wall time; phase maxima are separate diagnostics and never summed. Numeric measure sums are rank work, not elapsed time. Engine work imbalance uses active workers only. Process CPU includes MPI progress; elapsed minus CPU is not MPI wait. The native wait phase is subset completion only. For M<N, active_worker_exclusive is a separately closed worker row; inactive subset waiting can dominate the global critical row. Tracked bytes include self traffic and omit some direct/vendor communication. RSS is a process lifetime high-water mark. Different stages/events remain separate; event_index is the within-stage log ordinal, not a shared cycle identifier.
